title: Regression in BuildSystem Windows (MSVC) can not build with scons arguments  "debug_symbols=true" "dev_build=true" "dev_mode=true"
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Master

### System information

Windows 11

### Steps to reproduce

run scons with either arguments "debug_symbols=true" "dev_build=true" "dev_mode=true"

Your default compiler should be MSVC
```bash
scons debug_symbols=true
```
